```{bash}
#| include: false
set -uo pipefail
kubectl config current-context | grep -q '^kind-'
```

```{bash}
helm upgrade --install thalamus-crds "${THALAMUS_CHART_LOCATION}/thalamus-crds" --namespace thalamus --create-namespace --wait --timeout=600s --version "$THALAMUS_CHART_VERSION"
```

```{bash}
helm upgrade --install thalamus "${THALAMUS_CHART_LOCATION}/thalamus" --namespace thalamus --wait --timeout=600s --version "$THALAMUS_CHART_VERSION" --set operator.image.tag="$OPERATOR_IMAGE_TAG"
```

```{bash}
kubectl create secret generic hf-token --from-literal=HF_TOKEN="$HF_TOKEN" --namespace thalamus
```

```{bash}
kubectl apply -f "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${REPOSITORY}/${REF}/examples/model-smollm2-cpu.yaml"
```

```{bash}
kubectl wait model --all --namespace thalamus --for=condition=Ready --timeout=600s
```

```{bash}
export MODEL="$(kubectl get model --namespace thalamus -o json | jq -r '.items[0].spec.weights.hf.repoId')"
```

```{bash}
kubectl wait gateway/inference-gateway --namespace thalamus --for=condition=Programmed=True --timeout=120s
```

```{bash}
kubectl port-forward svc/inference-gateway 8080:80 --namespace thalamus &
sleep 3
```

::: details Verify with the Python SDK
```{bash}
python3 -m pip install "openai>=2,<3" "anthropic>=0.49" && python3 - <<'EOF'
import os
from openai import OpenAI

model = os.environ["MODEL"]
client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:8080/v1", api_key="e2e", timeout=120.0)
ids = [m.id for m in client.models.list()]
assert model in ids, f"model {model!r} not in /v1/models: {ids}"
print("PASS: GET /v1/models")

prompt = "What is the capital of France? Answer with a single word."
completion = client.chat.completions.create(
    model=model,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
    max_tokens=8,
    temperature=0,
)
content = completion.choices[0].message.content or ""
assert "paris" in content.lower(), f"expected 'Paris' in chat completion, got: {content!r}"
print(f"PASS: POST /v1/chat/completions -> {content!r}")
EOF
```

```{bash}
python3 - <<'EOF'
import os
from openai import OpenAI

model = os.environ["MODEL"]
client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:8080/v1", api_key="e2e", timeout=120.0)
prompt = "What is the capital of France? Answer with a single word."
response = client.responses.create(model=model, input=prompt)
content = response.output_text
assert "paris" in content.lower(), f"expected 'Paris' in response, got: {content!r}"
print(f"PASS: POST /v1/responses -> {content!r}")
EOF
```

```{bash}
python3 - <<'EOF'
import os
from anthropic import Anthropic

model = os.environ["MODEL"]
client = Anthropic(base_url="http://localhost:8080", api_key="e2e", timeout=120.0)
prompt = "What is the capital of France? Answer with a single word."
message = client.messages.create(
    model=model,
    max_tokens=64,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
)
content = "".join(block.text for block in message.content if block.type == "text")
assert "paris" in content.lower(), f"expected 'Paris' in message, got: {content!r}"
print(f"PASS: POST /v1/messages -> {content!r}")
EOF
```
